answer: An operator running 179 keys as a result pays for 179 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the plume quota and the forge admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the relic ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 9 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
